acceptance_criteria: The selector is deterministic for identical typed facts and profile definitions, performs no host mutation or network access, and returns only applicable profiles with a reason and any unknown inputs.

Profiles cover runtime-patch, configuration, incident-triage, and source-review intent, with applicability for Apache mod_php, PHP-FPM, CLI, containers, distribution/vendor provenance, extensions, and relevant configuration.
Missing facts remain unknown; unsupported SAPI and unknown vendor backport status are explicit and are not automatically classified as vulnerable or fixed.
Tests prove stable selection, unsupported-SAPI handling, no cross-profile leakage, Debian PHP-FPM exclusion of Apache checks, no mutation, and bounded selected context.
The thin skill router loads only selector-returned profile content, keeps patch status distinct from compromise evidence, and never implies that a verified patch proves no compromise.
The project skill is registered through agent-loop configuration and Codex projection; doctor, host-status, skill validation, and CI detect projection drift.
behavior_anchors: Explicit task intent and runtime facts -> deterministic applicable profile IDs -> the skill loads only those profile resources.
PHP SAPI, runtime, OS/vendor, container, extension, and configuration facts -> applicability true, false, or unknown -> bounded guidance without inferred patch or compromise verdicts.
goal: Implement a deterministic, read-only PHP audit-profile selector and thin Codex skill router for guidance-mode audits.
non_goals: Do not port Cloudflare security-audit-skill wholesale, its broad prompt corpus, multi-agent orchestration, or full audit artifact/report pipeline; adapt only relevant evidence, coverage, independent-verification, and finding-state patterns without claiming endorsement.

Do not implement the PRA-3 evidence engine, PRA-4 collectors, vendor patch adjudication, PRA-5 remediation, production scans, active exploit payloads, sensitive evidence upload, or the PRA-6 public service.
